title: Keep the investor register current
summary: Record transfers, address changes and tax form updates so distributions and notices reach the right people.
outlineSteps: Keep one register as the record for every investor
Record each investor's legal name, ownership and contact details
Record payment instructions and confirm any change by phone
Collect and file each investor's tax form
Read the transfer terms before recording any transfer
Record each transfer with the approvals and documents behind it
Reconcile the register to capital accounts and distributions
Log every change with its date and source
Limit who can change the register
Ask investors to confirm their details on a set schedule
